sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for installations: how to comply

facts.source_fact: The 2026 free-allocation period is treated separately from the preceding and subsequent allocation periods.
facts.expected_handling: Version 2026 allocation independently.

facts.source_fact: Type 1 2026 incumbents are generally free-allocation installations from the 2021 to 2025 period subject to stated exceptions.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the Type-1 definition before classification.

facts.source_fact: Type 2 2026 incumbents include certain former electricity generators meeting the changed-definition conditions.
facts.expected_handling: Require evidence for the Type-2 criteria.

facts.source_fact: The Type-2 route depends in part on an operator statement in its 2027 to 2030 free-allocation application.
facts.expected_handling: Carry the operator-statement provenance.

facts.source_fact: 2026 free allocation is calculated in line with the Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading Scheme Amendment No. 2 Order 2025.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the governing legal version.

facts.source_fact: The allocation table contains a Standard A column for 2026 values.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the column identity when reading values.

facts.source_fact: The allocation table contains a NER B column for 2026 values.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the new-entrant-reserve column identity.

facts.source_fact: The allocation table contains a Total C column for 2026 values.
facts.expected_handling: Keep total values distinct from their component columns.

facts.source_fact: Some 2026 Standard A and NER B entries are intentionally blank while Total C contains a value.
facts.expected_handling: Do not interpret an intentional component blank as zero allocation.

facts.source_fact: The intentional blank components signify that the total free-allocation figure may still change through the 2025 Activity Level Change process.
facts.expected_handling: Mark the total as provisional where this pattern occurs.

facts.source_fact: Component cells are populated after the Authority approves any required entitlement adjustments.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer component values before approval.

facts.source_fact: Some 2026 figures are provisional and may change after 2025 activity-level adjustments are approved.
facts.expected_handling: Carry provisional status into downstream outputs.

facts.source_fact: The 2025 Activity Level Change process can affect 2026 entitlement.
facts.expected_handling: Attach ALC status to entitlement comparisons.

facts.source_fact: The allocation table reports free-allocation information for operators of installations.
facts.expected_handling: Do not aggregate to parcel level without a separate mapping.

facts.source_fact: Allocation-table values represent allowance entitlement, not measured greenhouse-gas emissions.
facts.expected_handling: Keep allowance entitlement separate from emissions measurements.

facts.source_fact: The allocation table is updated periodically to reflect allowance changes and new entrants.
facts.expected_handling: Store table vintage and retrieval date.

facts.source_fact: New entrants can cause updates to the allocation table.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assume a static installation population.

facts.source_fact: The regulator may instruct the Registry administrator to withhold free allowances.
facts.expected_handling: Separate table entitlement from registry delivery.

facts.source_fact: Free allowances are normally allocated to the operator holding account by 28 February each year.
facts.expected_handling: Track expected registry-delivery date separately.

facts.source_fact: An installation included in the relevant allocation table must comply with free-allocation conditions in its permit.
facts.expected_handling: Bind table inclusion to the correct permit version.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve table semantics and blank-value meaning.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents false zero or final-value claims.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach installation, incumbent type and allocation period.
Attach table vintage and ALC approval state.
Carry table column and legal-basis provenance.
Do not convert allowance entitlement into parcel emissions.
